TRAINING.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the instructions for this section…
TRAINING.EMPTY: No sections yet. Add the first one, for example ROL.
TRAINING.ROUTE_PHRASES: Customer phrases (this is what picks the route)
TRAINING.ROUTE_PHRASES_PLACEHOLDER: how much is it, pricing, i want a quote
TRAINING.ROUTE_DOES_NOTHING: It queries nothing and has nothing to do when it cannot solve: it answers only from the Training and may make up prices or schedules. If that is intended (greeting, asking for data), leave it.
TRAINING.ROUTE_UNKNOWN: %{value} — does not exist in this account
TRAINING.ROUTE_MODAL_HINT: A route is a topic the agent handles: which phrases pick it, where the answer comes from and what it does if it does not resolve.
TRAINING.ROUTE_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a route named "%{name}". For the engine only one exists: it keeps the first and the other is never picked.
TRAINING.ROUTE_NO_PHRASES: Without customer phrases this route will almost never be picked: it is the only thing the engine uses to decide.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE: What this route handles, in the agent's words
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_PLACEHOLDER: answers pricing questions and quotes from the current list
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_HINT: It goes as one line in the ALCANCE POR RAMA section, which is what the agent reads to know what it talks about in this topic. You can leave it empty and write it later.
TRAINING.ROUTE_AS_DEFAULT: This is the default route: messages that match no other one go here
TRAINING.ROUTE_DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove the route and its scope line
TRAINING.SECTION_MODAL_HINT: Sections are the instructions the agent reads, in the order they are written.
TRAINING.SECTION_MODAL_PREAMBLE: The leading text goes before the first section and has no label.
TRAINING.SECTION_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a section with that name. Two identical labels confuse the agent: it cannot tell which one applies.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_TITLE: Routes that already exist in this account
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_HINT: Copy a route from another agent, with its phrases, source and scope. You can edit it afterwards.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_SEARCH: Search by name, phrases, source or agent…
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_EMPTY: No routes written in any agent of this account yet.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_TITLE: Sections that already exist in this account
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_HINT: Copy a whole section from another agent, with its text. You can edit it afterwards. The same name may appear several times: those are the different ways it is written.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_SEARCH: Search by name, content or agent…
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_EMPTY: No sections written in any agent of this account yet.
TRAINING.ROUTE_FIND_ALL_TAKEN: This agent already has every route written in the account.
TRAINING.SECTION_FIND_ALL_TAKEN: This agent already has every section written in the account.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_MISSING: This source does not exist in the account: the route will find nothing.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_ADDED: Source added. This route can use it now.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SOURCE_ADD_ERROR: The source could not be added. Check the data and try again.
TRAINING.ROUTE_INTEGRATION_MISSING: @discourse uses the channel's Discourse integration, and the selected channel does not have it connected: the route will find nothing.
TRAINING.ROUTE_SCOPE_GENERATE_ERROR: It could not be generated. Try again or write it by hand.

PUBLISH.TITLE: Publish prompt
PUBLISH.DESCRIPTION: Other accounts will be able to download a copy of this prompt from their AI Agents Assistant and adapt it to their business. Later changes won't reach them until you publish a new version.

FORM.TITLE: Title
FORM.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What this agent does and which kind of business it fits

PUBLISH.NOT_PUBLISHED: Not published: the inbox, calendars, Knowledge Base, WhatsApp templates, labels or any file you don't check.
PUBLISH.REQUIREMENTS_TITLE: Whoever downloads it will need to set up in their account:
PUBLISH.NO_REQUIREMENTS: The prompt doesn't use resources from your account: nothing extra to set up.

FILES.TITLE: Agent files to publish
FILES.HELP: Every account that downloads the prompt gets a copy of the checked files. Don't check files that are only for your company.

VARIABLES.TITLE: Your business details (whoever downloads it fills them in)
VARIABLES.HELP: Write the texts in your Training that belong only to your company (name, phone, hours) and what they are called. In the published version they become a detail to fill in, and whoever downloads it fills it in the «Set up» tab. Your agent doesn't change.
VARIABLES.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Text in your Training (e.g. Northern Cranes)
VARIABLES.NOT_FOUND: It doesn't appear in the Training (outside directives and route lines): it can't be published like this.
VARIABLES.ELSEWHERE: it is also in Context or Objective: it isn't replaced there, keep it generic

PUBLISH.UPDATE_HINT: The author published a new version. Open it in the Assistant to see the changes.

NEW_AGENT.ASSISTANT: With the Assistant (chat, paste or import)

WORKSPACE.AGENT_ROLE_HINT: Training with the Assistant is edited by administrators.

VERSIONS.HINT: Every save that changes what the agent does is kept here, with where it was made. Restoring deletes nothing: the chosen version comes back as a new one.
VERSIONS.EMPTY: No versions yet: the first one is saved with the next change.
VERSIONS.LABEL: v{number}
VERSIONS.RESTORE_DESCRIPTION: The agent goes back to how it was in v{number}. Nothing is deleted: it is saved as a new version.
VERSIONS.RESTORED: Done: v{number} came back as v{version}.

WORKSPACE.NEW_DESCRIPTION: Build it with the Assistant: chat, paste or import a prompt, or download it from the Gallery.

REVIEW.HINT: Checker result on the published Training. Green «with topics»: working routes. Grey «conversational»: no topics, answers with the model only (not an error). Grey «no Training»: no instructions. Red «does not run · N»: N errors the engine cannot run; open it and the Training marks where they are.
REVIEW.ROUTED: With topics: it has working routes; it classifies what the customer asks and answers by topic.
REVIEW.CONVERSATIONAL: Conversational: it declares no topics and answers with the model only. Not an error.
REVIEW.EMPTY: No Training: it answers without its own instructions.
REVIEW.BROKEN: Does not run: it has errors the engine cannot run; that part does nothing and fails silently.

FICHA.SUG_PERSON: wants to talk to a person
FICHA.CONFIG_MISSING_SHEET: Say what the agent uses it for.

FICHA.QUESTIONS_HINT: What the agent asks, one at a time and in this order; each answer is saved so it isn't asked again.
FICHA.QUESTION_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Which system do you use today?
FICHA.QUESTION_OPTIONS: Options for the customer to choose (optional)
FICHA.QUESTIONS_AT_START: At the start, before answering anything else
FICHA.WELCOME_NO_FILES: Upload files in Files to send them with the welcome.
FICHA.IDENTITY_HINT: Who your agent is and what it is for. AI can propose the objective and context from what you select in Resources.
FICHA.OBJECTIVE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Help customers interested in renting cranes and book a visit
FICHA.SUGGEST_NEEDS_SOURCES: Select your data sources first so AI can propose it.
FICHA.NEED_OBJECTIVE: The agent objective is missing (at least 5 letters).
FICHA.FINISH_HINT: Test your agent with phrases like your customers' and check whether it is ready. When you like it, click Create agent.
FICHA.CREATE_HINT: Check the test in «Test and create» and click Create agent.
FICHA.QUESTIONS_WITH_WELCOME: Right after the welcome (the first question goes in the same message)
FICHA.QUESTIONS_FIRST_MESSAGE: When the conversation starts (the first question is the first thing the customer gets)
FICHA.WELCOME_WITH_QUESTION: The first question goes at the end of the welcome.
FICHA.FILES_NAME_EXPLAIN: The name is how the agent recognizes each file to send it; in the Training it shows as {tag}. Only letters, numbers, dash and underscore, no spaces.
FICHA.FILES_CONFIGURE_EXPLAIN: With «Configure» you choose when each file is sent: when the customer asks, with the welcome, in a follow-up attempt, in a route, when booking or when opening a ticket.
FICHA.FILE_RULE_SUBTITLE: Choose when the agent sends this file. You can choose several; if you choose none, the file is never sent.
FICHA.PROFILE_SAVED_HINT: Name, objective and context are saved with «Save ficha».
FICHA.QUESTION_OPTIONS_CHOICE: The agent offers these options and saves the one chosen:
FICHA.QUESTION_OPTIONS_FREE: Empty = the customer answers in their own words (name, city…). To make them choose from a list, type the options separated by commas.
FICHA.TICKET_REASONS_HINT: Tap a reason to use it: only the colored ones count. Type your own below (one per line or comma separated).
FICHA.PRESENTATION_PREVIEW: This is how the customer will see it
FICHA.QUESTIONS_EMPTY_TITLE: Do you want your agent to ask questions?
FICHA.QUESTIONS_EMPTY_HINT: They help to know the customer before helping: their name, city, which system they use… The agent asks them one at a time and saves each answer. If you want, AI proposes some examples from what you already entered; then you change or remove them.
FICHA.QUESTIONS_EMPTY_OPTIONAL: Optional: without questions, the agent answers directly.
FICHA.AGENDA_STEP_CALENDAR: 1. Which calendar are appointments booked in?
FICHA.AGENDA_STEP_CALENDAR_HINT: The agent looks for free slots in the selected calendars and books in one that has room.
FICHA.AGENDA_STEP_PRESENTATION: 3. How are the slots shown to the customer?
FICHA.SHEET_REMEMBER_HINT: Saves the «{column}» value the customer chose. If they later ask «how much is it?», the agent knows which one; if they name another, it changes by itself.
FICHA.SHEET_REMEMBER_INVALID: To remember it, the search column needs a simple name (letters, numbers and spaces).
FICHA.VARIABLES_HINT: What the agent remembers and changes while talking with the customer.
FICHA.VARIABLES_EMPTY_TITLE: Do you want your agent to remember something during the chat?
FICHA.VARIABLES_EMPTY_HINT: For example, whether it already sent the booking link (NO / YES) or how interested the customer is. Each variable starts with a value and changes when what you say happens.
FICHA.VARIABLES_EMPTY_SHEET: To remember what the customer chose from a sheet (the program, the product…), check «Remember what the customer chose» when configuring the sheet.
FICHA.VARIABLE_WHEN_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: I send the booking link
FICHA.BUSINESS_HINT: Your business data the agent uses when answering. It doesn't change during the conversation; if it changes (new phone), change it here.
FICHA.BUSINESS_EMPTY: Add the data the agent should have at hand.
FICHA.BUSINESS_FOOT: Questions are fixed data too: set them up in Questions.
FICHA.OBJECTIVE_AUTO_HINT: You can leave it empty: it is built from what you select (shown in gray). ✨ writes it better.
FICHA.CONTEXT_MISSING: Your agent doesn't know your business yet (empty AI context). AI can propose it from what you entered.
FICHA.TONE_CERCANO_HINT: Warm, like talking to someone from the business.
FICHA.TONE_PROFESIONAL_HINT: Kind and serious. Good for professional services.
FICHA.TONE_ENTUSIASTA_HINT: For sales: energetic and invites the next step.
FICHA.TONE_EMPATICO_HINT: For support, complaints or collections: acknowledges the issue first, then solves.
FICHA.ROUTES_TOO_MANY: Your agent has {count} topics (routes); {max} or fewer is recommended.
FICHA.ROUTES_TOO_MANY_HINT: With so many, the agent struggles to pick the right topic and may answer from the wrong source. They are not merged automatically because each topic searches its own source: unselect what this agent doesn't need.
